strengths: A new line on the hero piece. 'Watercolour, set in stone.' works twice: watercolour made permanent, and stones in their setting. 'cubic zirconia, not paint.' follows the winner's correction ('cubic zirconia, not candy.'). It hits the data's levers: Prism at ₹2,399 and in stock (68), a craft-material visual rhyme (a wash in the stones' three colours, with the bracelet laid along it), a light ivory ground, Feed 4:5. Every claim is a listing fact, and the idea reads at 390 px without the brush.

prism_r3c passes the plate (8.5, minor), and this review's own check agrees. It is a pixel-exact crop of the failed P10_a1 frame at [330, 200, 1330, 1977], so r1's three failures are out of frame: both clasp halves (75 and 260 px outside) and the brush (its tip 30 px past the right edge). The strip runs off both sides: an aqua sliver, then eight whole stones (P Y A P Y A P Y) at a 123 px pitch. There are no same-colour neighbours, and the hues sit inside the listing's range. Cushion stones sit in two-row pavé halos with four bead claws (stone/unit 0.67-0.69; real 0.65-0.69), in silver metal. No hard referent remains, and the soft ones read true at 14.5 px/mm: a cold-press tooth of about 0.55-1.4 mm, a wash about 5.7 cm deep, a postcard-size sheet.

The cleanest copy ground of the Prism set, with no glow or band. Headline 15.8:1 (darkest 5% 15.2), correction 16.4:1 (16.0), spec 12.3:1 (11.2), price 13.3:1 (12.2). The ink wordmark reads 13.6:1 (12.4), 179 px wide, 43 px above the price, its top level with the rule's (4 px). The copy ends at y 309, 450 px above the stones, and the halos end 291 px above the foot. 64 px margins.
issues: [placement] The sheet's deckled top edge (a faint highlight and a step from the pink backdrop to the cream paper, y 206-212) runs through the foot of 'SET IN STONE.' (caps y 156-227), 14-20 px above the baseline. At 390 px the headline looks as if it stands on a shelf.

[placement, minor] At the frame's edges (prism_r3c): the right edge kisses the last yellow stone's bezel (visible at 2x), and the bottom edge clips the wash's ragged lower edge, so paper shows under the CTA at x < 350.

[ceiling: photo] prism_r3c's minor notes land on the punchline. The yellows carry a radial starburst and the pinks fine streaks, instead of listing-7's crisscross facets; the yellows' rays show at 1:1, where P01_a1's stones are crisp. The link gaps are 12-14% of a unit, against 4-6% on the real piece and 8-9% on P01 and P02_a2c, so the line reads a little airier. The light is soft and flat with no kicker on the rims, and the aqua-pink overlap is a grey-lilac band. None of it shows at 390 px. Ceiling 9.5.

[placement] A new line, not a new picture. It is P01_a1's mechanic ('Rangoli, in a line.', 10): the bracelet as a straight horizontal line across aqua, pink and yellow on ivory, top-down, in the same layout and foot. Only the medium (a wash rather than powder bands), the line and the scale differ (units 123 px against P01_a1's 92). At 390 px the two read as siblings, and in one ad set they would compete for the same audience.

[no layout fix] 10 needs crisp brilliant facets, units that nearly touch and a hard kicker on the rims: a reshoot of the real piece on the painted sheet, or a regenerated frame.

[run] Run it as P01_a1's challenger in the Prism Feed ad set (Meta's creative test or equal budgets), not as a third concept beside prismC1_m1 and P01_a1. The winner keeps the slot. If P01_a1 wins, keep this as its refresh for after Diwali, when rangoli dates and watercolour does not.

strengths: The same new line and plate as P10_a1c: the full 9:16 plate (the cut prism_r3c scores at 8.5) at a 1.08x upscale. There is no extension, and the strip runs off both sides with eight whole stones (pitch 133 px). The pun reads at 390 px, and every claim is a listing fact.

Stories-safe and clean, with no glow, band or CTA (Meta adds its own). The copy sits at y 302-545 and the foot at 1422-1528. Headline 15.7:1 (15.0), correction 16.2:1 (15.8), spec 12.3:1 (11.2), price 13.3:1 (12.0). The ink wordmark reads 13.7:1 (12.7), 43 px above the price, and the halos end 225 px above it.
issues: [placement] The sheet's top edge (y 530-543) runs along the correction's baseline (y 534; glyphs 505-544), so 'cubic zirconia, not paint.' sits on the edge. It shows at 390 px.

[brand, minor] The frame ends inside the cast shadow of the sheet's bottom deckle: a dark band (down to RGB about 124,109,94) along the bottom 21 px (y 1899-1919). It sits under Meta's reply bar, but reads as a dirty edge in previews. As in the Feed, the right edge kisses the last yellow stone's bezel.
[ceiling: photo] As P10_a1c: the stones' starburst and streaks, the airier link gaps, flat light and the grey-lilac overlap. Ceiling 9.5.

[placement] A third Prism Story behind P02_a2c and P01_a1-story (both 10). Like P01_a1-story it is a horizontal band in a tall frame (the halos fill 114 of 1920 px), where P02_a2c's vertical line fills the height with 13 units.
